text: dsh-claude-marketplace 将 Claude Code 的技能、命令和 agent 定义接入 DSH。它在 DSH 注册工具，可扫描项目的 .claude 目录、管理 Claude Code marketplace，并把已安装组件登记为带 cc 前缀的 DSH 技能。适合希望在 DSH 中复用 Claude Code 插件生态的用户。安装后可设置缓存目录和导入技能名前缀；GitHub shorthand marketplace 来源会从 github.com 克隆。

dsh-claude-marketplace imports Claude Code skills, commands, and agents into DSH. Its tools scan project .claude folders, manage marketplaces, and register installed components as DSH skills. Configure the cache directory and skill prefix; GitHub shorthand sources are cloned from github.com.
想把项目里的 Claude Code 技能和命令接到 DSH 里使用。
如何从 Claude Code 插件市场安装插件，并把其中的 agent 定义注册成 DSH 技能？
I want to browse Claude Code marketplaces and use their plugin skills in DSH.
dsh-claude-marketplace 的功能「扫描并登记组件」：调用 cc_scan 扫描指定项目的 .claude 目录和已安装插件，将 skills、commands 与 agents 转成 DSH 技能并返回登记结果。
dsh-claude-marketplace 的功能「管理并安装插件」：用 cc_marketplace_add 添加 marketplace，再用 cc_plugin_install 安装插件并登记其中的组件。
dsh-claude-marketplace 使用 GitHub shorthand marketplace 来源时会访问 github.com 克隆仓库；代码未定义所需 API 密钥。

dsh-claude-marketplace README · dsh-claude-marketplace：Claude Code compatibility layer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): load Claude Code skills, commands and agents — from a project's `.claude` directory or from Claude Code **marketplaces** — as native dsh skills.

This is the ecosystem bridge: install any Claude Code plugin once and its components become callable dsh skills (prefixed `cc-`), reusing the huge Claude Code plugin/skills ecosystem inside DeepSeek Harness.

dsh-claude-marketplace README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-claude-marketplace
```

dsh-claude-marketplace README · Usage：Ask the model to use the `cc_*` tools, or drive them directly:

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `cc_scan` | Scan `<project>/.claude` + installed plugins; register every component as a dsh skill |
| `cc_marketplace_add` | Register a marketplace (local path, `owner/repo[#ref]`, or git URL) |
| `cc_marketplace_list` | List registered marketplaces and their plugins |
| `cc_plugin_install` | Install a plugin and register its skills/commands/agents |
| `cc_plugin_list` | List installed plugins |

dsh-claude-marketplace README · Usage：Example flow:

```
cc_marketplace_add("anthropics/claude-code")
cc_marketplace_list()
cc_plugin_install(plugin="commit-commands", marketplace="claude-code-plugins")
cc_scan()

Imported components are named `cc-<plugin>-<component>` (kebab-case, matching dsh's skill name contract), so they can never collide with native dsh skills. Original names are preserved in the `label` field (`my-plugin:review`).

dsh-claude-marketplace README · What is supported (v0.1)：- **Skills** — `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, plugin-root `SKILL.md`
- **Commands** — `commands/*.md` (flat, loaded as skills)
- **Agents** — `agents/**/*.md` (loaded as skills with a delegation header)
- **Marketplaces** — `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` with sources: relative path, `github`, `url`, `git-subdir`, `npm`, `archive`
- **Local `.claude`** — project-level skills/commands/agents (project trust)

dsh-claude-marketplace README · Not yet (v0.2+)：- **Hooks** — parsed but not executed (security: hooks are arbitrary code; an opt-in policy is planned)
- **MCP / LSP servers** — use dsh's native MCP client instead
- **Themes / monitors / workflows / output styles**
- `allowed-tools`, `model`, `effort` frontmatter semantics (documented, ignored for now)
- Auto-refresh of the skill catalog on file changes (run `cc_scan` manually)

dsh-claude-marketplace README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `cacheDir` | `~/.dsh/claude-plugins` | Cache root for marketplaces and installed plugins |
| `skillPrefix` | `cc` | Prefix for imported dsh skill names |

dsh-claude-marketplace README · Security：Installed plugins are copied into the cache (never referenced in place). Hooks are **not** executed in v0.1. Path traversal in marketplace relative sources is rejected. Review plugin sources before installing, exactly as you would for Claude Code itself.
